本版让内置 AI 能动手操作网页，并加入扫一扫。
This release lets the built-in AI operate web pages on its own, and adds a QR / barcode scanner.
- AI 现在能替你动手：读页面、列可点元素、打开网址、点按钮、填搜索框、滚动、返回、把文件加入下载队列
- The AI can now act: read pages, list clickable elements, open URLs, click buttons, fill inputs, scroll, go back and queue downloads.
- 说一句「帮我下载这个应用」，它会自己找到下载入口并把 APK 加进下载队列，自动带加速线路
- Say "download this app for me" and it finds the download entry, then queues the APK with mirror acceleration.
- 每一步都会显示在对话里（带 🛠 标记），不想让它动手可在设置里关掉「允许 AI 操作网页」
- Every step shows up in the chat (marked with 🛠), and "let AI operate pages" can be turned off in settings.
- 问它「你用的什么模型」，现在会如实回答，AI 面板顶部也显示当前模型
- Asking which model it runs now gets an honest answer, and the model is shown at the top of the AI panel.
- 扫一扫：主页搜索框右侧一键扫码，支持二维码与 EAN/UPC 等条形码，也能从相册选图识别
- Scanner: one tap to the right of the home search bar; QR codes plus EAN/UPC barcodes, and images picked from the gallery.
- 扫到网址直接打开，电话 / 邮件 / 位置交给系统，Wi-Fi、商品码、文本可复制或搜索，最近扫过保留 5 条
- URLs open right away, phone / mail / location go to the system, and Wi-Fi, product codes and text can be copied or searched; the last 5 scans are kept.
- 安装包约 1.5 MB，覆盖安装不丢数据
- About 1.5 MB, installs over the old version without losing data.
